name: Story Builder
description: Players take turns adding one sentence to a shared story. AI optionally polishes it at the end.
tagline: Perfect for collaborative storytelling, word chains, and sentence-by-sentence narratives.

opening.label: Story opening or prompt
opening.helper: What students are continuing. The first player picks up where this leaves off.
opening.placeholder: Once upon a time, a goose walked into a coffee shop and ordered…

turnTimer.label: Time per turn (seconds)
turnTimer.helper: How long each player has to add their sentence.

order.label: Turn order
order.helper: Random keeps things unpredictable. Join-order goes around the room in the order students joined.

template.name: Story: ${opening}
template.description: A collaborative story-building game built with the Story Builder recipe.

intro.message:
## Let's build a story together!

Everyone takes a turn adding one sentence. Try to keep the story going, don't end it on your turn!
